summary.text: Bert Gurr is a Republican member of the Nevada State Assembly who has represented District 33 since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists his profession as real estate broker.

paragraphs.text: Bert Gurr was born in Roosevelt, Utah, and graduated from Elko High School; his career experience includes owning a business and working as a real estate broker, and he served as president and treasurer of the Nevada Association of REALTORS.
He assumed office on November 9, 2022, succeeding John Ellison.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Government Affairs, Growth and Infrastructure, and Natural Resources committees.
